entries.title: Avro

entries.title: Axon Framework

timeline.description: Axon is currently in a stage of extensive trial within CTP for specific use cases that need a solution for event sourcing.

AH CTP Event Sourcing and CQRS trial within AH CTP for project E-value Targeted Offers: https://confluence-aholddelhaize.atlassian.net/wiki/x/fuVGvCI

timeline.description:
Business case for commercial Axon Server instead of OSS Axon framework looks promising, want to trial.

entries.title: Azure API Management [EEP v1]
entries.description: Azure API Management is a hybrid, multicloud management platform for APIs across all environments and used for employee facing applications running in Azure. This is the first generation Enterprise Enablement Platform offering, superseded by Azure API Management [EEP v2].

timeline.description: Deprecated in favour of Azure API Management [EEP v2]. Existing APIs can continue on v1, no new APIs should be onboarded.
Azure API Management is widely used across Tech NL
In trial at the RTP platform and used for employee applications

entries.title: Azure Functions
entries.description: Azure Functions is a serverless compute service that lets you run code on-demand without having to explicitly provision or manage infrastructure.

timeline.description: Only used by EEP Cloud team for automation purpose. Not ready for adoption fase

entries.title: Kafka [Confluent]
entries.description: Confluent Kafka is the strategic Kafka platform.

entries.title: Azure Cosmos DB
entries.description:
Azure Cosmos DB is the Azure native no-sql solution.

 MongoDB Atlas is the preferred solution over Azure Cosmos DB

MongoDB should be used instead

entries.title: CQRS
entries.description: Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) is an architectural pattern that separates data modification (Commands) from data retrieval (Queries) into distinct models.

timeline.description: Used in CTP

entries.title: Database schema change management
entries.description: Database schema change management (or schema migration) is the practice of tracking, reviewing, and automating updates to a database's structure, such as tables, columns, and indexes, as code.

timeline.description: Management of database structure and evolution via code (e.g. Liquibase)

entries.title: Docker Containers
entries.description: A Docker container is a runtime environment with all the necessary components, like code, dependencies, and libraries, needed to run the application code without using host machine dependencies.

timeline.description: used for deployments on kubernetes (Kaas)

entries.title: Event Sourcing
entries.description: Event sourcing is a software design pattern where changes to application state are stored as an ordered, immutable sequence of events rather than just the current state.

timeline.description: Used in CTP

entries.title: Event Streaming
entries.description: Event streaming revolves around the unbounded, sequential and real-time flow of data records, called 'events', foundational data structures that record any occurrence in the system or environment.

timeline.description: Part of the data strategy. Used to get changes to business objects into Thor

entries.title: Python API Framework [FastAPI]
entries.description: FastAPI framework, high performance, easy to learn, fast to code

timeline.description: In many Python projects FastAPI is used to create APIs as it is the default framework. As such it should be moved to Adopt to reflect reality.
Assessing FastAPI for Data Services & APIs at TechNL + S&A

entries.title: Python stream client (Faststream)
entries.description: Faststream is a python library that can be used to develop streaming microservices. It supports multiple brokers, such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Nats, Redis.

timeline.description: Assessing FastAPI for Data Services & APIs at TechNL + S&A

entries.title: Go-lang
entries.description: Go-lang is an open-source programming language supported by Google.

timeline.description: In trial at CTP platform - owner: Daniel Molenaar

entries.title: GraphQL as Service Interface
entries.description: GraphQL APIs enables clients to request exactly the data they need, and nothing more.

timeline.description: Retro fitting what should have been on the radar already.

entries.title: Java
entries.description: Java is a high-level, object-oriented programming language that is designed to be portable, secure, and platform-independent.

timeline.description: Any new development should be done using Kotlin (https://confluence-aholddelhaize.atlassian.net/wiki/x/cYHi1SI).
Java can be used as a language for the backend, but Kotlin is preferred

entries.title: JSON

timeline.description: Used in our APIs and in Kafka messages

entries.title: Kafka Streams
entries.description: Kafka Streams is a lightweight Java client library used for building real-time, scalable, and fault-tolerant stream processing applications that read from and write to Apache Kafka topics.

entries.title: Karate
entries.description: Low-code API Test automation framework that supports BDD-style predefined steps for writing the tests. Can be used for performance, and UI testing. Also, has an ability to produce and consume messages from Kafka.

timeline.description: Karate is confirmed as a relevant API test automation framework for Integration & Interoperability.

Karate framework PoC is done by EEP Phoenix team (Francois Pogieter, Anton Lilevsky), managerial contact - Silvija Klincharska. Karate is used in CTP(Ashok Rathnasabapathy, Alex Sijm), Gall&Gall(Bjorn van Lienen), RBP MDM(Avirup Das + Durga Marimuthu), STP Enablement(Abdel Al Bojaddaine), Etos(Soumya Rani Khamari).

entries.title: Kotlin
entries.description: Kotlin is a modern, statically-typed programming language designed for building apps that run on the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) and other platforms.

timeline.description: Kotlin is the preferred language for the backend

entries.title: ksqlDB
entries.description: ksqlDB is a distributed, real-time database purpose-built for streaming analytics and processing on Apache Kafka.

timeline.description: Confluent has dropped priority and switched focuss to Apache Flink

entries.title: MongoDB [Atlas]
entries.description: MongoDB Atlas is the choice of implementation for a non-SQL database. MongoDB Atlas is a fully-managed cloud database that handles all the complexity of deploying, managing, and healing your deployments on any public cloud service. Self hosted MongoDB is not allowed.

timeline.description: MongoDB is the first choice for non-SQL databases.
In Trial phase and used in most of the platforms. The enabling community is still building up

entries.title: MS SQL Server [Azure SQL DB]
entries.description: Microsoft SQL Server is a relational database management system (RDBMS) developed by Microsoft for storing, managing and retrieving data.

timeline.description: PostgreSQL is the preferred relational database for the Backend Tech Area. Not applicable to commercial off-the-shelf, third party or packaged solutions that internally use MS SQL Server / Azure SQL DB.
Microsoft SQL Server is one of the preferred solution for relational databases

entries.title: NodeJS [Backend]
entries.description: Node.js is the defacto standard for running JavaScript code outside of a browser. It is used as runtime for server and cli applications. Its module resolution system determines how shared libraries are structured, shared and linked to the application.

timeline.description: No new initiatives should be built in NodeJS.

entries.title: OpenTelemetry Protocol
entries.description: OpenTelemetry is a collection of tools, APIs, and SDKs. Use it to instrument, generate, collect, and export telemetry data (metrics, logs, and traces) to help you analyze your software's performance and behavior. (Currently only Traces are within the Trial scope)

entries.title: PostgreSQL [CloudNativePG]
entries.description:
PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database management system that emphasizes on extensibility, SQL compliance, and strong data integrity.

 CloudNativePG is the Kubernetes operator that covers the full lifecycle of a highly available PostgreSQL database cluster with a primary/standby architecture, using native streaming replication.
 It has potential to replace Azure managed PostgreSQL, but will require proper and mature support.

timeline.description: CloudNativePG could be an alternative to Azure managed PostgreSQL. It is fast, more flexible and the compute cost is lower. At this point in time it is lacking a TechNL team supporting it.

entries.title: Python Package Management [Poetry]
entries.description: A tool for dependency management and packaging in Python.

timeline.description: Moved to hold in favor of uv
Poetry is adopted as a package management tool for Python projects within Backend

entries.title: PostgreSQL [Azure Flexible Server]
entries.description:
PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database management system that emphasizes on extensibility, SQL compliance, and strong data integrity.


 Also covers Azure Database for PostgreSQL

timeline.description: The cloud resources platform (Duplo) is the preferred solution for managing Azure Database for PostgreSQL instances.
PostgreSQL is the preferred solution for relational databases

entries.title: Python
entries.description: Python is a general-purpose language used for automation and data analysis.

timeline.description:
Python is adopted only within GET and DDP for service development or data science.
Cloud Foundation team uses Python for automation scripts and Azure functions.
AH CTP decided to replace Perl by Python on the POS.
The Python paved road for microservices is currently in Alpha and can be used for evaluation purposes (assess).
Other platforms may use Python in restricted use cases.

Python is adopted only within GET and DDP for service development or data science. Cloud Foundation team uses Python for automation scripts and Azure functions. Other platforms may use Python in restricted use cases.
Python is widely in use in AholdDelhaize and standards are available.
Python is the preferred solution for automation and data analysis

entries.title: Redis [Azure managed Redis]
entries.description: Azure Managed Redis provides an in-memory data store based on the Redis Enterprise software. It is supported by Duplo.

timeline.description: The cloud resources platform (Duplo) supports Azure Managed Redis.

Currently there are many teams using Azure Managed Redis. TechNL enablement does not offer a managed equivalent and as such this implementation is considered preferred (https://confluence-aholddelhaize.atlassian.net/wiki/x/LIDs1SI).

entries.title: Redis [Azure Cache for Redis]
entries.description: Azure Cache for Redis provides an in-memory data store based on the Redis software and is supported by Duplo.

timeline.description: Azure Cache for Redis announced its retirement timeline for all SKUs. We recommend moving your existing Azure Cache for Redis instances to Azure Managed Redis as soon as you can. (https://confluence-aholddelhaize.atlassian.net/wiki/x/LIDs1SI).

entries.title: REST over HTTP
entries.description: REST is an architecture style heavily used in the backend to expose data by services

entries.title: REST Assured
entries.description: REST Assured is a popular, open-source Java/Kotlin library that provides a domain-specific language (DSL) for testing and validating RESTful APIs.

timeline.description: REST Assured is a popular open-source Java/Kotlin library used to test, validate, and automate RESTful APIs.

entries.title: Rust
entries.description: A language empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

timeline.description: Both DS&A and CTP have applied Rust for production use cases.
Rust seems to be the future language for all Data Engineering / Data Platform related work. Other areas are not as clear (Microservices for instance).

entries.title: Schema based contracts
entries.description: Schema-based contracts are agreements defining the structure, data types, and constraints of data exchanged between systems, often used in API development (GraphQL, REST) and data engineering to ensure compatibility.

timeline.description: Used in HTTP APIs and also in Kafka messages

entries.title: Schema Registry [Confluent]
entries.description: A Schema Registry is a centralized repository that manages and stores data schemas (e.g., Avro, JSON Schema, Protobuf) for data streaming systems, ensuring consistency and compatibility as data evolves.

timeline.description: Used by both Strimzi and Conlfuent clusters

entries.title: Spring AI
entries.description: Spring AI is an application framework designed for Java developers to integrate Artificial Intelligence capabilities, specifically Generative AI, into Spring Boot applications.

entries.title: Spring Boot
entries.description: Spring Boot makes it easy to create stand-alone, production-grade Spring based Applications that you can "just run".

timeline.description: Spring Boot is the preferred framework for backend (microservice) development within TechNL.

entries.title: Spring Cloud API Gateway
entries.description: Spring Cloud API Gateway is a tool for routing and filtering incoming HTTP requests to backend services in a microservices architecture.

timeline.description: Spring Cloud API Gateway is the preferred solution for API Gateway when dealing with customer data (CTP)

entries.title: Python GraphQL library (Strawberry)
entries.description: Strawberry is a python library for building GraphQL APIs.

timeline.description: Strawberry is the standard library for GraphQL python services in GET.

entries.title: Stream Processing
entries.description: Stream processing is a data management technique that ingests, analyzes, and acts on data immediately as it is generated, rather than waiting to collect it in batches.

timeline.description: Used and backed by Kafka Stream and other platforms and frameworks

entries.title: Kafka [Strimzi]
entries.description:
Strimzi is opensource and provides a way to run an Apache Kafka cluster on Kubernetes in various deployment configurations.


 Confluent Kafka is the prefered way to run a Kafka cluster

Confluent Kafka is the prefered way to run a Kafka cluster
Strimzi is the prefered way to run a Kafka cluster

entries.title: Structured Logging
entries.description: Structured logging is the practice of recording application logs in a consistent, machine-readable format (typically JSON) using key-value pairs rather than free-form text.

timeline.description: Structured logging as a technique is a common backend concern

entries.title: Testcontainers
